messages:
alisha: heads up — canary rollout of the stricter fncall validator (slice=canary-15) started throwing rejects around 09:12 UTC.
alisha: quick sample from logs: ```json
{
  "error": "output did not match schema",
  "path": "result.actions[0]",
  "expected": "object",
  "actual": "string"
}
```
max: did the routing fallback kick in or did requests just die?
ops-bot: reroute executed: route_id=rb-fallback-1, count=42
kevin: fallback did run, but downstream adapter threw `unexpected payload type` and returned 400, so result never made it to user
maria: we also saw quota burn — clients retrying after validation rejects + fallback duplicates caused a spike in billed tokens
jad: what telemetry do we currently emit? can we correlate validation rejects to fallback events?
alisha: right now we have `toolcall.validate.reject` and `route.fallback` events but they're not correlated by request_id, so console can't thread them together
max: that's an onboarding/UX gap — engineers have to cross-check two dashboards to debug these incidents
kevin: short fix: propagate a `request_id` through validator -> router -> adapter telemetry and add a `validation.reason` tag on rejects
maria: also add `tool_adapter.status` metric (ok|reject|error) so we can graph adapter failures alongside rejects
jad: short-term ops idea: add an alert that fires when both rejects and fallbacks spike in the same 5m window
alisha: tentative alert text: `WHEN rate(toolcall.validate.reject) > 5% AND rate(route.fallback) > 1% FOR 5m THEN PAGE SRE`
sre-oncall: will add alert and a runbook entry for this pattern; can we include a grep-able example log line to speed triage?
max: long-term: console should show a single fncall trace that includes validate -> route -> adapter spans so you can expand the full lifecycle
kevin: and we need quota-safety on fallback — duplicate requests can double-charge tenants, so maybe throttle fallback retries for canary traffic or mark them non-billable until we stabilize
maria: opening an RFC for telemetry + fallback quota-safety after this thread, will link here
alisha: thanks — I'll attach two redacted payload samples and a couple failing log lines in this thread now
alisha: sample grep log: `2026-03-19T09:12:34Z validator=fncall id=req-9a7b path=result.actions[0] expected=object actual=string`
kevin: can someone paste the adapter 400 body if available? that will help decide if it's a serde issue vs. validator mismatch
ops-bot: uploaded files: sample_payload_1.json, sample_payload_2.json
alisha: uploaded adapter error: ```json
{
  "status":400,
  "error": "invalid payload type: expected object, got string at result.actions[0]"
}
```
jad: OK next steps: (1) propagate request_id in telemetry (2) add validation.reason tag (3) short-term alert + runbook (4) checkbox on console roadmap for fncall end-to-end traces
max: I'll draft the telemetry PR, assigning myself + kevin to review
maria: I’ll include quota mitigation ideas in the RFC (throttle, bill-exempt for retries, canary gating)
sre-oncall: alert + runbook done, paging threshold set to sample to avoid noise
alisha: great — thanks everyone. ping me if you need the raw logs or tenant ids for the canary slice.
